mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fixed_asset WHERE 1=1 AND (asset_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR asset_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR owner_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY asset_no
SELECT r.*, a.asset_name FROM asset_change_request r JOIN fixed_asset a ON r.asset_no=a.asset_no WHERE r.request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE asset_change_request SET request_status=#{status}, decided_by=#{decidedBy}, decided_at=#{decidedAt} WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND request_status='PENDING'
UPDATE fixed_asset SET department=#{department}, owner_name=#{owner}, location_name=#{location} WHERE asset_no=#{assetNo}
UPDATE fixed_asset SET last_inspected_date=#{inspectedDate} WHERE asset_no=#{assetNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asset_change_request WHERE request_status='PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fixed_asset WHERE last_inspected_date IS NULL OR last_inspected_date < '2026-01-01'
